blocks.prompt: 18. The first term of an A.P. is \(a\), the second term is \(b\) and the last term is \(c\). Show that the sum of A.P. is \(\frac{(b + c - 2a)(c + a)}{2(b - a)}\).
blocks.explanation:
Yeh letters wala proof hai. A.P. ki pehli term \(a\), doosri term \(b\) aur aakhri term \(c\) di hai. Jama ke liye terms ki tadaad \(n\) chahiye jo nahi di; wohi is sawal ki chaabi hai.
Diya kya hai? \(a_1 = a\), \(a_2 = b\), aakhri term \(c\).
Saabit kya karna hai? Jama \(\frac{(b + c - 2a)(c + a)}{2(b - a)}\) hai.
Plan: \(d = b - a\), aakhri term ke formula se \(n\), phir \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\).
steps:
Diya gaya hai: \(a_1 = a\), \(a_2 = b\), aakhri term \(a_n = c\) (aur \(b \ne a\)).
Saabit karna hai: \(S_n = \dfrac{(b + c - 2a)(c + a)}{2(b - a)}\).
Tareeqa: Pehli do terms se \(d\) mil jata hai. Aakhri term ka formula \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) us \(n\) ko de dega jo nahi diya. Phir \(S_n = \frac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\) lagayenge kyunke pehli aur aakhri term (\(a\) aur \(c\)) dono maloom hain.

Common difference
\[d = a_2 - a_1 = b - a\]
Kyun: \(d\) hamesha doosri term minus pehli term hota hai. Yahan numbers ki jagah letters hain, lekin usool wohi hai.

Terms ki tadaad
\[c = a + (n - 1)(b - a)\]
\[n - 1 = \dfrac{c - a}{b - a}\]
\[n = \dfrac{c - a}{b - a} + 1\]
\[= \dfrac{c - a + b - a}{b - a}\]
\[= \dfrac{b + c - 2a}{b - a}\]
Kyun: Aakhri term \(c\) hi \(n\)th term hai, to \(a_n = a_1 + (n - 1)d\) mein rakha. Dono taraf se \(a\) minus kiya aur \((b - a)\) se divide kiya. Phir 1 jorne ke liye \(1 = \frac{b - a}{b - a}\) likha taake denominator same ho; upar \(c - a + b - a = b + c - 2a\).
Dhyan dein: \(n - 1\) nikaal kar ruk jana aam ghalti hai; 1 jorna na bhooliye.

A.P. ka jama
\[S_n = \dfrac{n}{2}(a_1 + a_n)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2} \cdot \dfrac{b + c - 2a}{b - a} \cdot (a + c)\]
\[= \dfrac{(b + c - 2a)(c + a)}{2(b - a)}\]
Kyun: \(n\) ki value, \(a_1 = a\) aur \(a_n = c\) formula mein rakhe. \(\frac{n}{2}\) ka matlab \(n \times \frac{1}{2}\), is liye 2 neeche denominator mein \((b - a)\) ke saath chala gaya. \(a + c\) aur \(c + a\) ek hi cheez hain. Yahi saabit karna tha.

Numbers se tasdeeq
\(a = 1,\ b = 4,\ c = 13\) lein: A.P. \(1, 4, 7, 10, 13\) hai.
\[1 + 4 + 7 + 10 + 13 = 35\]
\[\dfrac{(4 + 13 - 2)(13 + 1)}{2(4 - 1)}\]
\[= \dfrac{15 \times 14}{6} = 35 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Letters wala formula sahi hai ya nahi, yeh chhote numbers rakh kar foran pata chal jata hai. Haath se jama bhi 35 aur formula se bhi 35.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: \(S_n = \frac{(b + c - 2a)(c + a)}{2(b - a)}\).
